Author: Monk Layout contributors
Name: Monk & White Mage Layouts
Punchline: Monk and White Mage HUD presets, including a Wrath Combo hotbar profile.
Description: One-time keyboard and mouse setup. Monk uses HUD 4; White Mage manual and Wrath profiles use HUD 3 with a centered lily gauge and nearby party list. Fills the selected job's hotbars 1-3 and optionally sets keyboard bindings. Local backups and restore for each job; both White Mage profiles share the same original backup. Open /monklayout, /whmlayout or /whmwrath. Configure Wrath Combo separately.
Changelog: Adds /whmwrath and a separate White Mage profile with four combo buttons on 1-4, lily heals on 5 and R, and familiar manual movement and utility keys. Provides explicit buttons to open Wrath settings or pause/resume Auto-Rotation. Keeps all 35 White Mage actions, the original manual profile, Monk layout, global keyboard map and shared White Mage restore history.
